# Every Paper event scripts can listen to, with its fields. GENERATED by tools/events/EventList.java
# (Gradle task `events`, part of every build) from Paper's API: don't edit by hand. Read by EventBridge.java
# (plugin) and tools/docs/Docs.java (docs site).
# Event line: name <TAB> Java class <TAB> docs sub group <TAB> flags (cancellable, async: Paper fires it off the
#   main thread) or -
# Field line: <TAB> name <TAB> getter <TAB> read kind <TAB> setter <TAB> setter's parameter class <TAB> write kind
#   <TAB> enum: its class's simple name, ":" and its words when 16 or fewer (Result:deny,default,allow);
#   - where there is none
# KINDS: player entity world block chunk location vec3 block_pos aabb block_state damage item_stack component
#   text enum key uuid boolean integer number block_snapshot profile, and list:<kind> (a List, Set or
#   Collection); a list field without a setter can still have a write kind: Paper's list is meant to be changed
#   ?Type: Lullaby can't read (or set) a Type yet
